parameters.content:
## Mossgrove 1: Site Visit → Draft Quote
The estimator fills in the form in the garden (notes, a voice memo, photos). The memo is transcribed, then **GPT-5.4 picks items and quantities from the price book** (it never sees or sets prices). **Price Quote** works out every amount, VAT, the deposit and the days of work in code, and flags anything to check. The draft is saved to Google Sheets and the owner gets an email; nothing goes to the client until the owner sends it from the dashboard.
